svg.title: Variable library value sets: one library, one value set per environment
svg.text: Variable library value sets: one library, one value set per environment
Each workspace activates one value set. Items always read the active value set, so the same code gets each environment's IDs.
VARIABLE LIBRARY · CustomerDemographicsConfig (one item, stored in Git)
A value set stores only overrides. Every environment-specific ID must be overridden, otherwise that environment silently inherits the Default (Dev) value.
settings.json → "valueSetsOrder": ["uat", "prod"] · value set names must equal the environment the pipeline passes (the branch name).
MICROSOFT FABRIC WORKSPACES · each activates one value set
A setting on the library in each workspace
Not stored in Git, not in the definition
fabric-cicd sets it on every deployment
Active value set: Default value set
Set when Dev was created; not changed by CI/CD
SAME CODE IN EVERY WORKSPACE · no IDs in item definitions
